Watchdog alert channel.question: How does a stuck-publish alert reach you?
Watchdog alert channel.answer: Telegram via the existing bot/notification infrastructure

Watchdog alert channel.question: How does the watchdog run?
Watchdog alert channel.answer: Scheduled command (scheduler cadence, same pattern as existing dispatch/recovery commands)

Watchdog alert channel.question: Which conditions alert (vs just dashboard-visible)?
Watchdog alert channel.answer: Stuck past lease window + exhausted-retries permanent failure + repeated lease expiries (retry loop)

Watchdog alert channel.question: How are repeat alerts handled while a publish stays stuck?
Watchdog alert channel.answer: Once per content item per day while the condition holds

Error-tracking service.question: Which error-tracking service receives publish-path exceptions?
Error-tracking service.answer: Sentry SaaS (free tier, sentry/sentry-laravel SDK, DSN in app env — runtime credential, not ADR-0002 infra token)

Error-tracking service.question: What context attaches to reported exceptions?
Error-tracking service.answer: Same IDs as logs — workspace id, content id, job id, operation/run token, 1:1 with the publish log channel

Error-tracking service.question: What reports to the error tracker in this phase?
Error-tracking service.answer: Publish path only — publish Actions, provider clients, publish jobs, watchdog

Event capture & storage.question: Where do publish events (claim, checkpoint, retry, finalize) live?
How should the structured log channel emit?
Event capture & storage.answer: Dedicated JSON channel (one JSON object per line to stderr, Railway-ingested)

Event capture & storage.question: If we add a publish_events table, how long do rows live?
Event capture & storage.answer: Prune after 90 days via scheduled command

Event capture & storage.question: What should be instrumented in v1?
Event capture & storage.answer: Lifecycle + provider HTTP (claim/checkpoint/retry/finalize plus 429 waits, timeouts, 5xx in the clients)

Event capture & storage.question: One publish_events table for posts and videos, or separate tables?
Event capture & storage.answer: One morph table (publishable morph, workspace_id via BelongsToWorkspace, job id, stage, operation/run token, payload JSON)

Event capture & storage.question: How do events get written from the publish path?
Event capture & storage.answer: Recorder class — single PublishEventRecorder support class writes DB row + emits log line together

Event capture & storage.question: Should event rows share the checkpoint transaction?
Event capture & storage.answer: After commit, logs always — DB rows best-effort post-commit; log channel fires regardless

Event capture & storage.question: Where are publish events visible?
Event capture & storage.answer: Dashboard only; no new API v1 surface in this phase
